reference.shared: leaf; types.ts and remote-types.ts generated from the Rust backend; imported by all four packages via the 'shared/*' path alias
reference.@vibe/ui: UI component library; no workspace dependencies besides shared
reference.@vibe/web-core: application core (features, pages, hooks, api); depends on @vibe/ui and shared
reference.@vibe/local-web: local app shell; depends on @vibe/web-core and @vibe/ui; compiles web-core sources through the '@/*' alias
reference.@vibe/remote-web: remote app shell; depends on @vibe/web-core and @vibe/ui; same '@/*' alias to web-core sources
reference.direction: local-web / remote-web -> web-core -> ui -> shared, no reverse edges

rubric: ui has no workspace dependency (leaf besides shared)
local-web and remote-web depend on web-core and ui
shared is generated types used by the packages (generated from the Rust backend)
mentions that the app packages consume web-core sources directly through the '@/*' path alias
states the one-way direction apps -> web-core -> ui -> shared
